title: 📝 Summarization AI

messages.content: [Fizz System Spokesperson] My role is to act as the voice of the system and provide clear and concise descriptions of the tools we craft. I aim to ensure that the functionality, features, and specifications of each tool are well-defined and communicated effectively to our human engineers, like Denis. By using natural language processing, I can generate a detailed description of each tool, making it easier for the team to understand the requirements and specifications.
